app_unavailable: The new version did not become healthy, and the one before it is running again
caddy_unavailable: Caddy did not take the configuration
client_address_unavailable: The caller's address is needed and was not given
forbidden_parameter: This parameter is not accepted through the public API
github_unavailable: This node has no GitHub token, or no repositories to deploy from
invalid_address: This is not an address this host serves
invalid_body: The body is not one this route reads
invalid_cancellation: Cancelling needs the email and the token it was subscribed with
invalid_content_id: This is not a content id
invalid_declaration: The declaration is not one this node can run
invalid_derivation: This object has no such form
invalid_email: This is not an email address
invalid_home: A home has to be a path on this name other than /
invalid_image: The image archive could not be loaded
invalid_like: A like is true or false
invalid_locale: The site is not published in this locale
invalid_method: This route does not take this method
invalid_name: A name is one DNS label, and not one the platform keeps for itself
invalid_path: Every path starts with a scope, such as /geo/
invalid_port: Another app already holds this port
invalid_position: Latitude must be within 90 and longitude within 180
invalid_range: The range asked for is outside the object
invalid_repository: A notice names the repository its run belongs to, and this node deploys from it
invalid_resource: This is not a resource id
invalid_route: The route could not be stored
invalid_series: A series needs a grain of second, minute or hour, and whole seconds for since and until
invalid_signature: The signature does not match the body
invalid_size: The object is too large for this
invalid_target: Host does not act on itself; keeper replaces it
invalid_timing: Timeout is 1 to 30 seconds and delay 0.1 to 10, each to one decimal place
invalid_token: The token is missing or wrong
invalid_upload: An upload is the part service, then the part image
invalid_url: A capture needs a host, a scheme of http or https, and each part of the address alone
invalid_variable: A variable is named in capitals, digits and underscores, with its value on one line
invalid_viewport: Width is from 320 to 3840 and height from 240 to 2160
meter_unavailable: The meter did not answer on its socket
metrics_unavailable: No sample has been taken yet
no_such_article: No published article has this slug
no_such_asset: No asset is published under this name
no_such_check: No check is declared under this id
no_such_form: This resource has no canonical form
no_such_host: No service answers on this host
no_such_object: No object is stored at this address
no_such_picture: No picture is kept under this name; one is kept five minutes once its task is done
no_such_place: No place is known near this position
no_such_scope: No API is published under this scope
no_such_snapshot: The snapshot from before this version was deployed is no longer kept
no_such_subscription: No subscription matches this email and token
no_such_task: No task is kept under this id; tasks are kept five minutes
no_such_version: There is no previous version to go back to
page_unavailable: The page could not be captured
queue_unavailable: Too many captures are waiting; ask again shortly
rate_limited: Too many requests from this address; try again in a minute
scope_unavailable: This scope is not reachable from here
store_unavailable: The node's own records could not be read
upstream_unavailable: The service behind this one did not answer
